_comment: Curated spawn tiles for bosses absent from the OpenTibia world spawn file and the TibiaMaps/community marker sets (raid, quest and instanced bosses). slug -> {x,y,z,src}. Applied idempotently by `php artisan tibia:import-boss-locations` to bosses whose meta.spawns is still empty. Coordinates are absolute Tibia world coords sourced from TibiaWiki article 'Location' sections and TibiaMaps.io; each must land on an exported minimap tile (see tools check in the command).
